name: rational-delirium-ui
description: 理性失序 · Rational Delirium: independent local Markdown knowledge, evidence maps and controlled Agent revisions

scripts.build: npm run build:plugin && npm run build:agent
scripts.test:python: python -B -m unittest discover -s semantic-graph/tests && python -B -m unittest discover -s mutation-gate/tests
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run check-artifacts && npm run check-agent-artifacts && npm run test:python && npm run eval
scripts.eval: node scripts/eval-knowledge.mjs --replay-baseline && node scripts/eval-knowledge.mjs && node scripts/eval-roles.mjs
